import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def run(cols,names,n0=1.1):
    def resid(p):
        X=np.column_stack([c(p[0]) for c in cols])
        c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dA_dt,rcond=None)
        return X@c-dA_dt
    r=least_squares(resid,[n0])
    X=np.column_stack([c(r.x[0]) for c in cols]); cc,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dA_dt,rcond=None)
    print(np.round(r.x,5), np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(dA_dt), {nm:round(v,4) for nm,v in zip(names,cc)})
